Snapshot: midsize CCaaS operator focused on post-call intelligence. Primary customers are enterprise retail and telco contact centers. Wants turnkey post-call summaries that feed into ticket creation + QA scorecards. Also interested in an agent assist surface for live calls (short hints, suggested knowledge snippets) but priority is reliable post-call pipeline first. Key quotes: 'We need summaries our QA leads can trust — 1-2 bullets for coaching + action items.'

Bullet notes / shorthand:
- POC target: 2-week, 500 concurrent calls, peak bursts to 5k calls/hr.
- Must support native telephony transcript inputs (SIP gateway -> wav), speaker diarization, and confidence scores per utterance.
- RTO/RPO: want SLA 99.95% up-time for inference endpoints; failover to lower-cost model on overload acceptable.
- Cost sensitivity: mid — will trade modest latency for 25% cost savings via batching/quantization suggestions.
- Routing/fallback: need policy for fallbacks from hosted model to smaller on-prem quantized variant during spikes.
- Integration wishlist: automatic Zendesk ticket creation, update CRM fields via tool-calling, push coaching highlights to Slack channel.
- Security ask: transcripts encrypted at rest with customer-managed KMS, audit logs to be retained 2 years, SSO + SCIM for users.
- Evaluation metric: human QA correlation >0.78 vs current manual summaries.
